      <small data-t="mob_per"></small>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="c-mobtn" id="skt-mobtn" data-t="mob_knop"></button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>

  var root = document.getElementById('skt-calc');
  if(!root) return;

  /* =========================================================
     1. VRIJE PLEKKEN. Pas hier de getallen aan als er geboekt is.
        0 betekent vol: de periode wordt grijs en onklikbaar.
     ========================================================= */
  var PLEKKEN = {
    '1': 15,   // periode 1, 12 t/m 22 februari
    '2': 15    // periode 2, 4 t/m 14 maart
  };

  /* =========================================================
     1b. SPAMFILTER
     ========================================================= */
  var SPAM = {
    minSeconden:   3,     // sneller verstuurd dan dit is geen mens
    blokkeerLinks: true   // opmerkingen met een webadres worden geweigerd
  };
  var gestart = Date.now();

  /* =========================================================
     1c. reCAPTCHA v3
         De SITESLEUTEL uit Odoo:
         Instellingen > Website > Integraties > reCAPTCHA.
         Laat hem leeg en het formulier werkt gewoon zonder captcha.
     ========================================================= */
  var RECAPTCHA = {
    sitesleutel: 'REDACTED',
    actie:       'website_form'   // moet zo blijven, Odoo controleert hierop
  };

  // Zet op true zolang je aan het testen bent. De melding van Odoo komt dan
  // in beeld en in de console, zodat je ziet waarom het versturen mislukt.
  // Zet hem op false zodra het werkt.
  var TESTMODUS = true;

  if(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel && !window.grecaptcha){
    var rc = document.createElement('script');
    rc.src   = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=' + encodeURIComponent(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel);
    rc.async = true;
    rc.defer = true;
    document.head.appendChild(rc);
  }

  // wacht kort tot het script van Google geladen is
  function captchaKlaar(pogingen){
    return new Promise(function(klaar){
      (function kijk(n){
        if(window.grecaptcha && window.grecaptcha.execute) return klaar(true);
        if(n <= 0) return klaar(false);
        setTimeout(function(){ kijk(n - 1); }, 200);
      })(pogingen);
    });
  }

  // haalt het token op, geeft een lege string terug als er geen captcha is
  function captchaToken(){
    if(!RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel) return Promise.resolve('');
    return captchaKlaar(15).then(function(ok){
      if(!ok) return '';
      return new Promise(function(klaar){
        window.grecaptcha.ready(function(){
          window.grecaptcha.execute(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel, {action: RECAPTCHA.actie})
            .then(function(tk){ klaar(tk || ''); })
            .catch(function(){ klaar(''); });
        });
      });
    });
  }

                    'We will get in touch to go through your choices.'],

  /* =========================================================
     3. NIVEAUS, alleen voor de aanvrager zelf
     ========================================================= */
  var NIVEAUS = [
    {v:'Beginner',  nl:'Beginner, ik kite nog niet heel lang en kies vriendelijke condities uit',
                    en:'Beginner, I have not been kiting long and stick to easy conditions'},
    {v:'Gevorderd', nl:'Gevorderd, ik kan upwind kiten en kite in alle condities',
                    en:'Advanced, I can kite upwind and handle all conditions'},
    {v:'Ervaren',   nl:'Ervaren, ik kan kitefoilen, doe downwinders, kite in alle condities en kan downloopen',
                    en:'Experienced, I can kitefoil, do downwinders, handle all conditions and downloop'}
  ];

  /* ---------- taal bepalen: Nederlands of Engels ---------- */
  function isNederlands(){
    var pad = (location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    var m = pad.match(/^\/([a-z]{2})(?:[_-][a-z]{2})?(?:\/|$)/);
    if(m) return m[1] === 'nl';
    var l = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang') || '').toLowerCase();
    if(l) return l.indexOf('nl') === 0;
    return true;
  }
  var NL = isNederlands();
  var i  = NL ? 0 : 1;

  function t(sleutel){
    var r = TXT[sleutel];
    return r ? (r[i] || r[0]) : '';
  }

  // alle teksten in de pagina zetten
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(function(el){
    el.textContent = t(el.getAttribute('data-t'));
  });
  // teksten met opmaak erin, bijvoorbeeld <strong> of <br>
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-thtml]').forEach(function(el){
    el.innerHTML = t(el.getAttribute('data-thtml'));
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-tph]').forEach(function(el){
    el.setAttribute('placeholder', t(el.getAttribute('data-tph')));
  });
  var persSelect = document.getElementById('skt-personen');
  if(persSelect) persSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', t('pers_kop'));

  var sumBox     = document.getElementById('skt-sumlines');
  var totBox     = document.getElementById('skt-totaal');
  var onsiteWrap = document.getElementById('skt-onsite');
  var onsiteBox  = document.getElementById('skt-onsitelines');
  var hidSum     = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-sum');
  var hidTot     = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-tot');
  var hidOnsite  = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-onsite');
  var hidZelf    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-zelf');
  var zelfBox    = document.getElementById('skt-zelflines');
  var hidPeriode = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-periode');
  var hidTaal    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-taal');
  var hidPers    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-pers');
  var hidMede    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-mede');
  var hidNiveau  = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-niveau');
  var periodeBox = document.getElementById('skt-periodebox');
  var personenSel= persSelect;
  var medeBox    = document.getElementById('skt-mede');
  var moTotaal   = document.getElementById('skt-mototaal');
  var moBar      = document.getElementById('skt-mobar');
  var moBtn      = document.getElementById('skt-mobtn');
  var form       = document.getElementById('skt-form');

  if(hidTaal) hidTaal.value = NL ? 'Nederlands' : 'Engels';

  function fmt(n){
    return NL
      ? n.toLocaleString('nl-NL', {minimumFractionDigits:0, maximumFractionDigits:0}) + ',-'
      : '€ ' + n.toLocaleString('en-GB', {minimumFractionDigits:0, maximumFractionDigits:0});
  }

  // vaste bedragen in de keuzelijst
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-bedrag]').forEach(function(el){
    el.textContent = fmt(parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-bedrag')) || 0);
  });

  // resterende plekken per periode
  root.querySelectorAll('input[data-periode]').forEach(function(inp){
    var vrij  = parseInt(PLEKKEN[inp.getAttribute('data-periode')], 10);
    var label = inp.parentNode.querySelector('.c-plekken');
    if(!label || isNaN(vrij)) return;

    if(vrij <= 0){
      label.textContent = t('vol');
      label.className = 'c-plekken is-vol';
      inp.disabled = true;
      inp.closest('.c-opt').classList.add('is-vol');
    }else if(vrij === 1){
      label.textContent = t('plek_vrij1');
      label.className = 'c-plekken is-laag';
    }else{
      label.textContent = vrij + t('plek_vrij');
      label.className = 'c-plekken' + (vrij <= 4 ? ' is-laag' : '');
    }
  });

  /* ---------- deelnemers ---------- */
  function niveauOpties(){
    var out = '';
    NIVEAUS.forEach(function(n){
      out += '<option value="' + n.v + '">' + (NL ? n.nl : n.en) + '</option>';
    });
    return out;
  }

  function bouwMedereizigers(){
    if(!medeBox) return;
    var n = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;

    var oud = {};
    medeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-mede]').forEach(function(el){
      oud[el.getAttribute('data-mede')] = el.value;
    });

    // deelnemer 1 is de aanvrager zelf, die vult alleen zijn niveau in
    var html = '<div class="c-mede">' +
                 '<p class="c-medekop">' + t('jij') + '</p>' +
                 '<div class="c-mederij is-solo">' +
                   '<select data-mede="niveau1">' + niveauOpties() + '</select>' +
                 '</div>' +
               '</div>';

    // de overige deelnemers geven alleen hun naam door, zij boeken zelf
    for(var k = 2; k <= n; k++){
      html += '<div class="c-mede">' +
                '<p class="c-medekop">' + t('deelnemer') + k + '</p>' +
                '<div class="c-mederij is-solo">' +
                  '<input type="text" data-mede="naam' + k + '" placeholder="' + t('naam_ph') + '">' +
                '</div>' +
              '</div>';
    }
    medeBox.innerHTML = html;

    medeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-mede]').forEach(function(el){
      var sleutel = el.getAttribute('data-mede');
      if(oud[sleutel] !== undefined) el.value = oud[sleutel];
    });
  }

  function eigenNiveau(){
    var el = medeBox ? medeBox.querySelector('[data-mede="niveau1"]') : null;
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  function medereizigersTekst(){
    if(!medeBox) return t('geen');
    var n = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;
    var uit = [];
    for(var k = 2; k <= n; k++){
      var naam = medeBox.querySelector('[data-mede="naam' + k + '"]');
      if(!naam) continue;
      uit.push(t('deelnemer') + k + ': ' + (naam.value || '-'));
    }
    return uit.length ? uit.join(' | ') : t('geen');
  }

  /* ---------- rekenen ---------- */
  function bereken(){
    var regels = [];
    var onsite = [];
    var zelf   = [t('zelf_vlucht'), t('zelf_verz')];
    var totaal = 0;

    var per = root.querySelector('input[name="skt-periode"]:checked');
    if(per){
      periodeBox.classList.remove('is-leeg');
      periodeBox.innerHTML = '<strong>' + t(per.getAttribute('data-key')) + '</strong>' + t(per.getAttribute('data-note-key'));
      if(hidPeriode) hidPeriode.value = t(per.getAttribute('data-key')) + ': ' + t(per.getAttribute('data-note-key'));
    }else{
      periodeBox.classList.add('is-leeg');
      periodeBox.textContent = t('prompt');
      if(hidPeriode) hidPeriode.value = t('niet_gekozen');
    }

    regels.push({label:t('basis'), bedrag:1899});
    totaal += 1899;

    root.querySelectorAll('.c-opt input:checked:not([disabled])').forEach(function(inp){
      var label = t(inp.getAttribute('data-key'));

      if(inp.hasAttribute('data-zelf')){
        zelf.push(t(inp.getAttribute('data-zelf')));
        return;
      }

      if(inp.hasAttribute('data-onsite')){
        onsite.push({label:label, note:t(inp.getAttribute('data-note-key'))});
        return;
      }

      var prijs = parseFloat(inp.getAttribute('data-price') || '0');
      if(!prijs) return;
      regels.push({label:label, bedrag:prijs});
      totaal += prijs;
    });

    var html = '';
    var plat = [];
    regels.forEach(function(r){
      html += '<div class="c-sumline"><span>' + r.label + '</span><span>' + fmt(r.bedrag) + '</span></div>';
      plat.push(r.label + ': ' + fmt(r.bedrag));
    });

    var personen = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;

    sumBox.innerHTML = html;
    totBox.textContent = fmt(totaal);
    if(moTotaal) moTotaal.textContent = fmt(totaal);
    if(hidPers)   hidPers.value = String(personen);
    if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
    if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();

    var htmlOn = '';
    var platOn = [];
    onsite.forEach(function(r){
      htmlOn += '<div class="c-sumline"><span>' + r.label + '</span><span>' + r.note + '</span></div>';
      platOn.push(r.label + ' (' + r.note + ')');
    });
    onsiteBox.innerHTML = htmlOn;
    onsiteWrap.hidden = onsite.length === 0;

    if(zelfBox){
      var htmlZelf = '';
      zelf.forEach(function(r){ htmlZelf += '<li>' + r + '</li>'; });
      zelfBox.innerHTML = htmlZelf;
    }
    if(hidZelf)   hidZelf.value = zelf.join(' | ');

    if(hidSum)    hidSum.value = plat.join(' | ');
    if(hidTot)    hidTot.value = fmt(totaal);
    if(hidOnsite) hidOnsite.value = platOn.length ? platOn.join(' | ') : t('geen');
  }

  root.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var groep = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-exclusief');
    if(groep && e.target.checked){
      root.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusief="' + groep + '"]').forEach(function(ander){
        if(ander !== e.target) ander.checked = false;
      });
    }
    if(e.target === personenSel) bouwMedereizigers();
    bereken();
  });

  if(medeBox){
    medeBox.addEventListener('input', function(){
      if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
      if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();
    });
    medeBox.addEventListener('change', function(){
      if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
      if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();
    });
  }

  if(moBtn){
    moBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var naam = document.getElementById('skt-naam');
      if(form) form.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
      if(naam) setTimeout(function(){ naam.focus({preventScroll:true}); }, 500);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- versturen ---------- */
  var succesBox = document.getElementById('skt-succes');
  var foutBox   = document.getElementById('skt-fout');
  var knop      = document.getElementById('skt-submit');
  var knopTekst = knop ? knop.textContent : '';

  function token(){
    if(window.odoo && window.odoo.csrf_token) return window.odoo.csrf_token;
    var el = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"][value]:not([value=""])');
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  function post(velden){
    var fd = new FormData();
    Object.keys(velden).forEach(function(k){ fd.append(k, velden[k]); });
    fd.append('csrf_token', token());
    return fetch('/website/form/' + (form.getAttribute('data-model_name') || 'mail.mail'), {
      method:'POST', body:fd, credentials:'same-origin'
    }).then(function(r){
      return r.text().then(function(tekst){
        var data = null;
        try { data = JSON.parse(tekst); } catch(e){}
        return { status:r.status, data:data, tekst:tekst };
      });
    });
  }

  function waarde(id){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  if(form){
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!form.checkValidity()){ form.reportValidity(); return; }

      // spamcontrole: verborgen veld, te snel verstuurd, of een link in de opmerkingen
      var hp      = document.getElementById('skt-website');
      var teSnel  = (Date.now() - gestart) < SPAM.minSeconden * 1000;
      var heeftLink = SPAM.blokkeerLinks && /https?:\/\/|www\./i.test(waarde('skt-opm'));

      if((hp && hp.value) || teSnel || heeftLink){
        // geen foutmelding tonen, anders weet de bot dat hij tegengehouden is
        form.hidden = true;
        succesBox.hidden = false;
        if(moBar) moBar.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      bereken();
      foutBox.hidden = true;
      knop.disabled = true;
      knop.textContent = t('bezig');

      var aanvraag = {};
      form.querySelectorAll('input[name], select[name], textarea[name]').forEach(function(el){
        if(el.name === 'csrf_token' || el.name === 'skt-website') return;
        aanvraag[el.name] = el.value;
      });

      captchaToken().then(function(tk){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.log('[SKT] captcha token:', tk ? tk.slice(0, 12) + '... (lengte ' + tk.length + ')' : 'GEEN TOKEN');
        if(tk) aanvraag['recaptcha_token_response'] = tk;
        return post(aanvraag);

      }).then(function(res){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.log('[SKT] status', res.status, 'antwoord:', res.data || res.tekst);
        var d = res.data;
        if(d && d.error)        throw new Error(typeof d.error === 'string' ? d.error : JSON.stringify(d.error));
        if(d && d.error_fields) throw new Error('velden geweigerd: ' + JSON.stringify(d.error_fields));
        if(!d || !d.id){
          var kort = (res.tekst || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 180);
          throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status + ' | ' + (kort || 'leeg antwoord'));
        }

        form.hidden = true;
        succesBox.hidden = false;
        if(moBar) moBar.style.display = 'none';
        succesBox.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});

      }).catch(function(err){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.error('[SKT] versturen mislukt:', err);
        knop.disabled = false;
        knop.textContent = knopTekst;
        foutBox.textContent = t('fout') + (TESTMODUS && err && err.message ? ' [' + err.message + ']' : '');
        foutBox.hidden = false;
      });
    });
  }

  bouwMedereizigers();
  bereken();
})();
</script>
</section>
</template>

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.getElementById('skt-calc');
  if(!root) return;

  /* =========================================================
     1. VRIJE PLEKKEN. Pas hier de getallen aan als er geboekt is.
        0 betekent vol: de periode wordt grijs en onklikbaar.
     ========================================================= */
  var PLEKKEN = {
    '1': 15,   // periode 1, 12 t/m 22 februari
    '2': 15    // periode 2, 4 t/m 14 maart
  };

  /* =========================================================
     1b. SPAMFILTER
     ========================================================= */
  var SPAM = {
    minSeconden:   3,     // sneller verstuurd dan dit is geen mens
    blokkeerLinks: true   // opmerkingen met een webadres worden geweigerd
  };
  var gestart = Date.now();

  /* =========================================================
     1c. reCAPTCHA v3
         De SITESLEUTEL uit Odoo:
         Instellingen > Website > Integraties > reCAPTCHA.
         Laat hem leeg en het formulier werkt gewoon zonder captcha.
     ========================================================= */
  var RECAPTCHA = {
    sitesleutel: 'REDACTED',
    actie:       'website_form'   // moet zo blijven, Odoo controleert hierop
  };

  // Zet op true zolang je aan het testen bent. De melding van Odoo komt dan
  // in beeld en in de console, zodat je ziet waarom het versturen mislukt.
  // Zet hem op false zodra het werkt.
  var TESTMODUS = true;

  if(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel && !window.grecaptcha){
    var rc = document.createElement('script');
    rc.src   = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=' + encodeURIComponent(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel);
    rc.async = true;
    rc.defer = true;
    document.head.appendChild(rc);
  }

  // wacht kort tot het script van Google geladen is
  function captchaKlaar(pogingen){
    return new Promise(function(klaar){
      (function kijk(n){
        if(window.grecaptcha && window.grecaptcha.execute) return klaar(true);
        if(n <= 0) return klaar(false);
        setTimeout(function(){ kijk(n - 1); }, 200);
      })(pogingen);
    });
  }

  // haalt het token op, geeft een lege string terug als er geen captcha is
  function captchaToken(){
    if(!RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel) return Promise.resolve('');
    return captchaKlaar(15).then(function(ok){
      if(!ok) return '';
      return new Promise(function(klaar){
        window.grecaptcha.ready(function(){
          window.grecaptcha.execute(RECAPTCHA.sitesleutel, {action: RECAPTCHA.actie})
            .then(function(tk){ klaar(tk || ''); })
            .catch(function(){ klaar(''); });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* =========================================================
     2. ALLE TEKST. Links Nederlands, rechts Engels.
        De HTML bevat geen woorden, alles komt hiervandaan.
     ========================================================= */
  var TXT = {
    // periode
    periode_kop:   ['Kies je periode', 'Choose your dates'],
    periode_sub:   ['Er zijn twee reisperiodes, allebei met een beperkt aantal plekken.',
                    'There are two trip periods, each with a limited number of places.'],
    p1:            ['Periode 1', 'Period 1'],
    p1_d:          ['Vrijdag 12 februari tot en met maandag 22 februari 2027',
                    'Friday 12 February to Monday 22 February 2027'],
    p1_kort:       ['Vr 12 t/m ma 22 februari 2027', 'Fri 12 to Mon 22 February 2027'],
    p2:            ['Periode 2', 'Period 2'],
    p2_d:          ['Donderdag 4 maart tot en met zondag 14 maart 2027',
                    'Thursday 4 March to Sunday 14 March 2027'],
    p2_kort:       ['Do 4 t/m zo 14 maart 2027', 'Thu 4 to Sun 14 March 2027'],

    // personen

  /* =========================================================
     3. NIVEAUS, alleen voor de aanvrager zelf
     ========================================================= */
  var NIVEAUS = [
    {v:'Beginner',  nl:'Beginner, ik kite nog niet heel lang en kies vriendelijke condities uit',
                    en:'Beginner, I have not been kiting long and stick to easy conditions'},
    {v:'Gevorderd', nl:'Gevorderd, ik kan upwind kiten en kite in alle condities',
                    en:'Advanced, I can kite upwind and handle all conditions'},
    {v:'Ervaren',   nl:'Ervaren, ik kan kitefoilen, doe downwinders, kite in alle condities en kan downloopen',
                    en:'Experienced, I can kitefoil, do downwinders, handle all conditions and downloop'}
  ];

  /* ---------- taal bepalen: Nederlands of Engels ---------- */
  function isNederlands(){
    var pad = (location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    var m = pad.match(/^\/([a-z]{2})(?:[_-][a-z]{2})?(?:\/|$)/);
    if(m) return m[1] === 'nl';
    var l = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang') || '').toLowerCase();
    if(l) return l.indexOf('nl') === 0;
    return true;
  }
  var NL = isNederlands();
  var i  = NL ? 0 : 1;

  function t(sleutel){
    var r = TXT[sleutel];
    return r ? (r[i] || r[0]) : '';
  }

  // alle teksten in de pagina zetten
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(function(el){
    el.textContent = t(el.getAttribute('data-t'));
  });
  // teksten met opmaak erin, bijvoorbeeld <strong> of <br>
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-thtml]').forEach(function(el){
    el.innerHTML = t(el.getAttribute('data-thtml'));
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-tph]').forEach(function(el){
    el.setAttribute('placeholder', t(el.getAttribute('data-tph')));
  });
  var persSelect = document.getElementById('skt-personen');
  if(persSelect) persSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', t('pers_kop'));

  var sumBox     = document.getElementById('skt-sumlines');
  var totBox     = document.getElementById('skt-totaal');
  var onsiteWrap = document.getElementById('skt-onsite');
  var onsiteBox  = document.getElementById('skt-onsitelines');
  var hidSum     = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-sum');
  var hidTot     = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-tot');
  var hidOnsite  = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-onsite');
  var hidZelf    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-zelf');
  var zelfBox    = document.getElementById('skt-zelflines');
  var hidPeriode = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-periode');
  var hidTaal    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-taal');
  var hidPers    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-pers');
  var hidMede    = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-mede');
  var hidNiveau  = document.getElementById('skt-hidden-niveau');
  var periodeBox = document.getElementById('skt-periodebox');
  var personenSel= persSelect;
  var medeBox    = document.getElementById('skt-mede');
  var moTotaal   = document.getElementById('skt-mototaal');
  var moBar      = document.getElementById('skt-mobar');
  var moBtn      = document.getElementById('skt-mobtn');
  var form       = document.getElementById('skt-form');

  if(hidTaal) hidTaal.value = NL ? 'Nederlands' : 'Engels';

  function fmt(n){
    return NL
      ? n.toLocaleString('nl-NL', {minimumFractionDigits:0, maximumFractionDigits:0}) + ',-'
      : '€ ' + n.toLocaleString('en-GB', {minimumFractionDigits:0, maximumFractionDigits:0});
  }

  // vaste bedragen in de keuzelijst
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-bedrag]').forEach(function(el){
    el.textContent = fmt(parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-bedrag')) || 0);
  });

  // resterende plekken per periode
  root.querySelectorAll('input[data-periode]').forEach(function(inp){
    var vrij  = parseInt(PLEKKEN[inp.getAttribute('data-periode')], 10);
    var label = inp.parentNode.querySelector('.c-plekken');
    if(!label || isNaN(vrij)) return;

    if(vrij <= 0){
      label.textContent = t('vol');
      label.className = 'c-plekken is-vol';
      inp.disabled = true;
      inp.closest('.c-opt').classList.add('is-vol');
    }else if(vrij === 1){
      label.textContent = t('plek_vrij1');
      label.className = 'c-plekken is-laag';
    }else{
      label.textContent = vrij + t('plek_vrij');
      label.className = 'c-plekken' + (vrij <= 4 ? ' is-laag' : '');
    }
  });

  /* ---------- deelnemers ---------- */
  function niveauOpties(){
    var out = '';
    NIVEAUS.forEach(function(n){
      out += '<option value="' + n.v + '">' + (NL ? n.nl : n.en) + '</option>';
    });
    return out;
  }

  function bouwMedereizigers(){
    if(!medeBox) return;
    var n = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;

    var oud = {};
    medeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-mede]').forEach(function(el){
      oud[el.getAttribute('data-mede')] = el.value;
    });

    // deelnemer 1 is de aanvrager zelf, die vult alleen zijn niveau in
    var html = '<div class="c-mede">' +
                 '<p class="c-medekop">' + t('jij') + '</p>' +
                 '<div class="c-mederij is-solo">' +
                   '<select data-mede="niveau1">' + niveauOpties() + '</select>' +
                 '</div>' +
               '</div>';

    // de overige deelnemers geven alleen hun naam door, zij boeken zelf
    for(var k = 2; k <= n; k++){
      html += '<div class="c-mede">' +
                '<p class="c-medekop">' + t('deelnemer') + k + '</p>' +
                '<div class="c-mederij is-solo">' +
                  '<input type="text" data-mede="naam' + k + '" placeholder="' + t('naam_ph') + '">' +
                '</div>' +
              '</div>';
    }
    medeBox.innerHTML = html;

    medeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-mede]').forEach(function(el){
      var sleutel = el.getAttribute('data-mede');
      if(oud[sleutel] !== undefined) el.value = oud[sleutel];
    });
  }

  function eigenNiveau(){
    var el = medeBox ? medeBox.querySelector('[data-mede="niveau1"]') : null;
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  function medereizigersTekst(){
    if(!medeBox) return t('geen');
    var n = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;
    var uit = [];
    for(var k = 2; k <= n; k++){
      var naam = medeBox.querySelector('[data-mede="naam' + k + '"]');
      if(!naam) continue;
      uit.push(t('deelnemer') + k + ': ' + (naam.value || '-'));
    }
    return uit.length ? uit.join(' | ') : t('geen');
  }

  /* ---------- rekenen ---------- */
  function bereken(){
    var regels = [];
    var onsite = [];
    var zelf   = [t('zelf_vlucht'), t('zelf_verz')];
    var totaal = 0;

    var per = root.querySelector('input[name="skt-periode"]:checked');
    if(per){
      periodeBox.classList.remove('is-leeg');
      periodeBox.innerHTML = '<strong>' + t(per.getAttribute('data-key')) + '</strong>' + t(per.getAttribute('data-note-key'));
      if(hidPeriode) hidPeriode.value = t(per.getAttribute('data-key')) + ': ' + t(per.getAttribute('data-note-key'));
    }else{
      periodeBox.classList.add('is-leeg');
      periodeBox.textContent = t('prompt');
      if(hidPeriode) hidPeriode.value = t('niet_gekozen');
    }

    regels.push({label:t('basis'), bedrag:1899});
    totaal += 1899;

    root.querySelectorAll('.c-opt input:checked:not([disabled])').forEach(function(inp){
      var label = t(inp.getAttribute('data-key'));

      if(inp.hasAttribute('data-zelf')){
        zelf.push(t(inp.getAttribute('data-zelf')));
        return;
      }

      if(inp.hasAttribute('data-onsite')){
        onsite.push({label:label, note:t(inp.getAttribute('data-note-key'))});
        return;
      }

      var prijs = parseFloat(inp.getAttribute('data-price') || '0');
      if(!prijs) return;
      regels.push({label:label, bedrag:prijs});
      totaal += prijs;
    });

    var html = '';
    var plat = [];
    regels.forEach(function(r){
      html += '<div class="c-sumline"><span>' + r.label + '</span><span>' + fmt(r.bedrag) + '</span></div>';
      plat.push(r.label + ': ' + fmt(r.bedrag));
    });

    var personen = personenSel ? (parseInt(personenSel.value, 10) || 1) : 1;

    sumBox.innerHTML = html;
    totBox.textContent = fmt(totaal);
    if(moTotaal) moTotaal.textContent = fmt(totaal);
    if(hidPers)   hidPers.value = String(personen);
    if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
    if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();

    var htmlOn = '';
    var platOn = [];
    onsite.forEach(function(r){
      htmlOn += '<div class="c-sumline"><span>' + r.label + '</span><span>' + r.note + '</span></div>';
      platOn.push(r.label + ' (' + r.note + ')');
    });
    onsiteBox.innerHTML = htmlOn;
    onsiteWrap.hidden = onsite.length === 0;

    if(zelfBox){
      var htmlZelf = '';
      zelf.forEach(function(r){ htmlZelf += '<li>' + r + '</li>'; });
      zelfBox.innerHTML = htmlZelf;
    }
    if(hidZelf)   hidZelf.value = zelf.join(' | ');

    if(hidSum)    hidSum.value = plat.join(' | ');
    if(hidTot)    hidTot.value = fmt(totaal);
    if(hidOnsite) hidOnsite.value = platOn.length ? platOn.join(' | ') : t('geen');
  }

  root.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var groep = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-exclusief');
    if(groep && e.target.checked){
      root.querySelectorAll('[data-exclusief="' + groep + '"]').forEach(function(ander){
        if(ander !== e.target) ander.checked = false;
      });
    }
    if(e.target === personenSel) bouwMedereizigers();
    bereken();
  });

  if(medeBox){
    medeBox.addEventListener('input', function(){
      if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
      if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();
    });
    medeBox.addEventListener('change', function(){
      if(hidMede)   hidMede.value = medereizigersTekst();
      if(hidNiveau) hidNiveau.value = eigenNiveau();
    });
  }

  if(moBtn){
    moBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var naam = document.getElementById('skt-naam');
      if(form) form.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
      if(naam) setTimeout(function(){ naam.focus({preventScroll:true}); }, 500);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- versturen ---------- */
  var succesBox = document.getElementById('skt-succes');
  var foutBox   = document.getElementById('skt-fout');
  var knop      = document.getElementById('skt-submit');
  var knopTekst = knop ? knop.textContent : '';

  function token(){
    if(window.odoo && window.odoo.csrf_token) return window.odoo.csrf_token;
    var el = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"][value]:not([value=""])');
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  function post(velden){
    var fd = new FormData();
    Object.keys(velden).forEach(function(k){ fd.append(k, velden[k]); });
    fd.append('csrf_token', token());
    return fetch('/website/form/' + (form.getAttribute('data-model_name') || 'mail.mail'), {
      method:'POST', body:fd, credentials:'same-origin'
    }).then(function(r){
      return r.text().then(function(tekst){
        var data = null;
        try { data = JSON.parse(tekst); } catch(e){}
        return { status:r.status, data:data, tekst:tekst };
      });
    });
  }

  function waarde(id){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    return el ? el.value : '';
  }

  if(form){
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!form.checkValidity()){ form.reportValidity(); return; }

      // spamcontrole: verborgen veld, te snel verstuurd, of een link in de opmerkingen
      var hp      = document.getElementById('skt-website');
      var teSnel  = (Date.now() - gestart) < SPAM.minSeconden * 1000;
      var heeftLink = SPAM.blokkeerLinks && /https?:\/\/|www\./i.test(waarde('skt-opm'));

      if((hp && hp.value) || teSnel || heeftLink){
        // geen foutmelding tonen, anders weet de bot dat hij tegengehouden is
        form.hidden = true;
        succesBox.hidden = false;
        if(moBar) moBar.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      bereken();
      foutBox.hidden = true;
      knop.disabled = true;
      knop.textContent = t('bezig');

      var aanvraag = {};
      form.querySelectorAll('input[name], select[name], textarea[name]').forEach(function(el){
        if(el.name === 'csrf_token' || el.name === 'skt-website') return;
        aanvraag[el.name] = el.value;
      });

      captchaToken().then(function(tk){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.log('[SKT] captcha token:', tk ? tk.slice(0, 12) + '... (lengte ' + tk.length + ')' : 'GEEN TOKEN');
        if(tk) aanvraag['recaptcha_token_response'] = tk;
        return post(aanvraag);

      }).then(function(res){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.log('[SKT] status', res.status, 'antwoord:', res.data || res.tekst);
        var d = res.data;
        if(d && d.error)        throw new Error(typeof d.error === 'string' ? d.error : JSON.stringify(d.error));
        if(d && d.error_fields) throw new Error('velden geweigerd: ' + JSON.stringify(d.error_fields));
        if(!d || !d.id){
          var kort = (res.tekst || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 180);
          throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status + ' | ' + (kort || 'leeg antwoord'));
        }

        form.hidden = true;
        succesBox.hidden = false;
        if(moBar) moBar.style.display = 'none';
        succesBox.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});

      }).catch(function(err){
        if(TESTMODUS) console.error('[SKT] versturen mislukt:', err);
        knop.disabled = false;
        knop.textContent = knopTekst;
        foutBox.textContent = t('fout') + (TESTMODUS && err && err.message ? ' [' + err.message + ']' : '');
        foutBox.hidden = false;
      });
    });
  }

  bouwMedereizigers();
  bereken();
})();
</script>
</section></div>

        <div id="myCollapse1788856550828" class=" accordion">
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button justify-content-between gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550830" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550829" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550829"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">What is a hut tour?</font><br/></span></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550828" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550829" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550830">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>During a hut trip, we snowkite through the area with the group. We don't make a loop back to the bus, but head towards a beautiful destination: a staffed mountain hut where we will spend the night. Your gear and toiletry bag go along on the sled.<br/>There, it is warm, you receive a meal, and you can often enjoy the aftermath of the trip without internet access.<br/><br/><img src="/web/image/896040-dc8c282a/IMG_9035.webp" alt="" data-attachment-id="767725" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="1258" data-original-id="767716" data-original-src="/web/image/767716-8edbea51/IMG_9035.jpeg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/><br/><br/><img src="/web/image/896038-f5d521a1/IMG_3109.webp" alt="" data-attachment-id="896036" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="1258" data-original-id="896036" data-original-src="/web/image/896036-e90a3401/IMG_3109.jpeg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button justify-content-between gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550832" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550831" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550831"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">How cold can&nbsp;it get?</font><br/></span></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550828" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550831" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550832">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>In February and March, the temperature usually fluctuates between +3 °C and -12 °C, with extremes reaching around -29 °C. Due to the wind, it feels significantly colder: at -10 °C and 15 knots, the wind chill temperature is already -19 °C.<br/>Don't worry about the cold; we will prepare you well and share knowledge to keep you comfortable in the area.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button justify-content-between gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550834" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550833" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550833"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">How do I stay warm during a tour?</font><br/></span></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550828" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550833" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550834">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Good heat management means that you don't overheat and also don't get too cold. Take off a layer before you start sweating and put one on before you get cold; these are skills we will inform you about in detail before and during the trip.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
                </div>
            <div class="o_grid_item g-col-lg-6 g-height-5 col-lg-6 o_colored_level" style="z-index: 2; grid-area: 1 / 7 / 6 / 13;">
                    <div data-name="Accordion" data-snippet="s_accordion" class="s_accordion">
        <div id="myCollapse1788856550835" class=" accordion">
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button justify-content-between gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550837" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550836" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550836"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">What does winter camping involve?</font></span><br/></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550835" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550836" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550837">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <div>Do you like to take a (big) step further?</div><div>​</div><div>Immerse yourself in the ultimate freedom, silence, and emptiness of Hardangervidda and camp for 1 or 2 days in the snow.</div><div>​</div><p>With two or three of us, we tour ski into the area with the sleds. We plan winter camping on nice days with clear nights, and if the wind cooperates, we can of course go snowkiting.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            </div></div>
                </div></div>
        </div>
    </section><section class="s_title pb24 o_colored_level pt0" data-vcss="001" data-snippet="s_title" data-name="Title">
        <div class="container s_allow_columns">
            <h2 class="display-3-fs" style="text-align: center;"><font class="text-o-color-1">&nbsp;Material and safety</font></h2>
        </div>
    </section><section class="s_shape_image pt0 o_colored_level pb64" data-snippet="s_shape_image" data-name="Shape image">
        <div class="container">
            <div class="row o_grid_mode" data-row-count="5">

                <div class="o_grid_item g-col-lg-6 g-height-4 col-lg-6 o_colored_level" style="grid-area: 1 / 1 / 5 / 7; z-index: 1;">
                    <div data-name="Accordion" data-snippet="s_accordion" class="s_accordion">
        <div id="myCollapse1788856550842" class=" accordion">
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550844" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550843" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550843"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">Can I rent equipment?</font><br/></span></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550842" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550843" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550844">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Yes. Every day we have a wide selection of tubekites and foil kites available for rent in all sizes for the entire trip or by the day. <br/>This means you can also come without kites and fully rely on our rental kites. We have plenty!<br/>&nbsp;<br/>Additionally, touring skis with skins and boots, as well as snowboards including snowshoes, are available for rent.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550846" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550845" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550845"><span class="flex-grow-1"><font class="text-o-color-1">What kite sizes should I bring?</font></span><br/></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550842" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550845" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550846">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>It depends on your weight and whether you are on skis or a snowboard.<br/>As a guideline for someone weighing between 70 to 90 kg: on a snowboard, about 7, 10, and 13+ m²; on skis, about 6, 8, and 11 m². Lighter kiters go one size smaller, heavier ones go one size larger.<br/><br/>A kite that stays well in the air in very light wind is essential. Regular (normal Dacron) tube kites larger than 11m typically do not meet this requirement.<br/>With our knowledge session, we provide more information and can brainstorm with you.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
                </div>
            <div class="o_grid_item g-col-lg-6 g-height-5 col-lg-6 o_colored_level" style="z-index: 2; grid-area: 1 / 7 / 6 / 13;">
                    <div data-name="Accordion" data-snippet="s_accordion" class="s_accordion">
        <div id="myCollapse1788856550849" class=" accordion">
            <div class="accordion-item position-relative z-1" data-name="Accordion Item">
                <button type="button" class="accordion-header accordion-button justify-content-between gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" id="myCollapseBtn1788856550851" data-bs-target="#myCollapseTab1788856550850" aria-controls="myCollapseTab1788856550850"><span class="flex-grow-1">What safety rules apply?</span><br/></button>
                <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#myCollapse1788856550849" role="region" id="myCollapseTab1788856550850" aria-labelledby="myCollapseBtn1788856550851">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Always wear your helmet and backpack. You should check the contents of your backpack every morning. You don't want to find out in the area that you've forgotten your lunch or climbing skins when the wind dies down.<br/>Also, roll up your lines immediately when your kite is down. In short, think ahead and follow the decisions and instructions of the guides.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            </div></div>
                </div></div>
        </div>

                    <section class="s_text_block pt0 pb64 o_colored_level" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_9" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1"><strong>We are not a standard group trip!</strong></font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator"><hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/></div><ul class="lead"><li class="oe-nested">With our unique setup, you can go at your own pace and get the most out of the snowkiting trip at your level. Each session, there are multiple guides/instructors available to help and challenge you, whether you are a beginner or an advanced (snow)kiter.</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested">The journey and all the options below are the result of 15 years of listening to the participants, the extensive experiences within our own team, and thoroughly evaluating and brainstorming after each edition on how it can be even better.</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested">All so that we can give you an unforgettable trip and above all, the ultimate snowkite experience every time!</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested">We are therefore extremely proud that the Versus Snowkite trip has been a well-known concept in the Netherlands for years.</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested">--&gt; Are you curious why we do things a certain way? We’re happy to explain!<img src="/web/image/907316-45e2af45/collage-3.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907309" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907309" data-original-src="/web/image/907309-6bab6156/collage-3.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/><br/><br/><img src="/web/image/907315-1954bb08/IMG_1977.jpeg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907310" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907310" data-original-src="/web/image/907310-03aaf1c5/IMG_1977.jpeg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></li></ul></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 o_colored_level pb0" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="container s_allow_columns">
                            <h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_2" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1"><font style="color: rgb(8, 82, 148);"><strong>Backcountry tours with guide</strong></font></font></h2>
                            <div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator">
                                <hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/>
                            </div>
                            <p class="lead"><font class="text-o-color-1">Are you an experienced kiter? We will take you into the area on breathtaking trips ranging from 20-100km (depending on your level). You will traverse large parts of the area where the only thing on the horizon is endless snow.<br/>Our extensive and years of experience in the area is our "secret ingredient." This gives you access to parts of the area that you wouldn't reach without experience.<br/><br/>We make this accessible for many levels, so it's definitely not just for the "pros." These trips are, of course, optional and highly dependent on the conditions.<br/><br/>One of our guides always stays at the starting point, so even if you want to cruise, race, or freestyle at the home spot, there is always guidance nearby.</font></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767951-5b1ecd2c/IMG_2106.jpeg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767713" data-original-src="/web/image/767713-dfea5aa9/tempImage3l1LEK.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767713"/></p><p class="lead"><br/></p></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 pb64 o_colored_level" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_11" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1"><strong>Travel and transportation</strong></font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator"><hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/></div><ul class="lead"><li>Traveling relaxed from the Netherlands with just carry-on luggage? No problem, we take care of the rest! We will bring your equipment (max 20 kg or optionally 35 kg) from the Netherlands. This way, you can pack lighter and enjoy the fantastic views on the luxury train to the hotel, where we will pick you up again. We also have transportation ready for you in Norway to always get to the best spots in the vast area.&nbsp;<br/><br/></li><li>Plane + train to hotel (Recommended!)</li><li class="oe-nested">Travel time: 9 hours</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li>Book your flight and train ticket in advance yourself: Oslo Gardermoen Airport  <br/>(we have already found the best round-trip flight and train connection to the hotel for you, which you will receive by email). Train:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.vy.no," class="o_translate_inline">www.vy.no,</a>&nbsp;uitstaphalte: Haugastøl of Ustaoset.<br/><br/></li><li class="oe-nested"><img src="/web/image/907318-ee9101c3/YB222333.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907304" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907304" data-original-src="/web/image/907304-e21e86e0/YB222333.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/><br/><br/><img src="/web/image/907319-5cc3f206/YB222045.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907305" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907305" data-original-src="/web/image/907305-f07a4dbc/YB222045.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested"><img src="/web/image/907321-3d5c387f/20200304_120504.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907306" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907306" data-original-src="/web/image/907306-6a6015a9/20200304_120504.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></li></ul></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 pb64 o_colored_level" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_8" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1"><strong>Hotel and Restaurant</strong></font></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator"><hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/></div><ul class="lead"><li><font class="text-o-color-1">The hotel is located on the edge of the Hardangervidda area, and you can reach the best spots in no time. The small-scale hotel is run by snowkite professional Bjørn Kaupang and his family, and it has an incredibly cozy atmosphere where everyone feels at home right away.<br/><br/>The decor of the hotel is warm, cozy Norwegian, and has plenty of spots to be alone with a good coffee, book, or laptop and free wifi.&nbsp;Furthermore, you are surprised every evening by the creations of chef Liv Kaupang with chicken, game, fish, fantastic vegetables, and several vegetarian dishes each night. <br/>(and we haven't even mentioned the magical desserts yet!)</font></li></ul><img src="/web/image/761867-d5e1cb90/IMG_5447.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="761866" data-original-src="/web/image/761866-d5e1cb90/IMG_5447.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="761866"/><br/><br/><img src="/web/image/767957-c08a1f90/20230223_195125.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767956" data-original-src="/web/image/767956-c08a1f90/20230223_195125.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767956"/></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 pb64 o_colored_level" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_1" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1"><strong>Apartment and bedroom options</strong></font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator"><hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/></div><ul class="lead"><li>In the hotel, you stay in a luxury apartment that consists of 2 floors. The apartment is equipped with all conveniences, including a spacious, fully equipped kitchen, a large balcony, and a very large living area with a seating area and a big dining table. In the 8-person apartment, you share 80m2, which includes 2 x 4-person bedrooms.<br/><br/></li><li>You also have the option to upgrade your stay to a 2-person bedroom. In that case, we will book a 4-person apartment where you will share 40m2, which includes 2x 2-person bedrooms.</li><li class="oe-nested">You share this with your travel companion, or 1 other person who has booked this additionally.</li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li>Would you prefer the luxury of your own private bedroom? That’s possible too! <br/>We ensure that the other bed remains empty, so you have the whole bedroom to yourself. <br/>However, you may share the apartment with 1 or 2 others in the other bedroom.<br/><strong><br/>The luxurious and spacious 4-person apartment is equipped with all conveniences, including a large, fully equipped kitchen, a big balcony, and a very large living area with a seating area and a large dining table.</strong></li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li class="oe-nested"><img src="/web/image/907317-ff3cd862/44-22182ad843-2048.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907267" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907267" data-original-src="/web/image/907267-28aebfd9/44-22182ad843-2048.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/><br/><br/><img src="/web/image/907320-bdeecce3/48-fd349a5267-2048.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907268" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907268" data-original-src="/web/image/907268-edc96a84/48-fd349a5267-2048.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></li></ul></div>
                    </section>
                    <section class="s_text_block pt0 o_colored_level pb0" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="container s_allow_columns"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_3" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1">Hut Tours</font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator">
                                <hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/>
                            </div><p class="lead">When in Norway, do as the Norwegians do!&nbsp;</p><p class="lead"><span style="font-size: 1.125rem;">After an intensive day tour, we spend the night in a remote but staffed hikers' cabin. Inside, it's warm, you can dry your things by the fireplace, and join in for dinner!&nbsp;Incl. use of expedition materials, kite materials, first round, dinner, breakfast + lunch, overnight stay, and bed linen.</span></p><p class="lead">We plan for kite conditions, but if the wind is disappointing, we strap on the climbing skins or snowshoes.</p><p class="lead">A relatively accessible way to experience this breathtaking environment in a unique way!</p><p class="lead"><br/></p><p class="lead"><strong>Level and material indication:</strong></p><ul class="lead"><li><strong>Kite: average experience (smooth sailing, naturally gaining altitude, confident kiting in 12-35 knots)</strong></li><li><strong>Ski: intermediate level, own shoes (preferably touring boots), touring bindings. Snowboard: intermediate level, snow shoes (rent)</strong></li><li><strong>Clothing/items: The better material or prepare to purchase/rent this after consultation (kite material is included).</strong></li><li><span style="font-size: 1.125rem;"><strong>Overall condition: able to bike a long distance (50km) without issues within 2.5 hours, able to walk long distances.</strong></span></li></ul><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/907348-218b6e2d/IMG_5494.jpeg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907341" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="825" data-original-id="907341" data-original-src="/web/image/907341-5bce2b9a/IMG_5494.jpeg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767724-fc2f25f5/tempImagejMdzsT.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767715" data-original-src="/web/image/767715-fc2f25f5/tempImagejMdzsT.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767715"/></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767725-8edbea51/IMG_9035.jpeg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767716" data-original-src="/web/image/767716-8edbea51/IMG_9035.jpeg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767716"/></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767731-97a84693/YB222339.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767727" data-original-src="/web/image/767727-97a84693/YB222339.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767727"/></p></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 o_colored_level pb0" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_7" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1">Winter camping</font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator">
                                <hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/>
                            </div><p class="lead">Do you like to take a (big) step further?</p><p class="lead">Immerse yourself in the ultimate freedom, silence, and emptiness of Hardangervidda and camp for 1 or 2 nights in the snow. (2 or 3 days outdoors)</p><p class="lead">With two or three of us, we go touring on skis with the sleds into the area. We plan winter camping on nice days with clear nights, and if the wind cooperates, we can of course go snowkiting.</p><p class="lead">This falls within the regular periods, the other days the hotel is the base.</p><p class="lead"><strong>Level and material indication:</strong></p><ul class="lead"><li><strong>Kite: downwinder experience (minimum 10x) Ski: intermediate level, own shoes (preferably touring boots), touring bindings.</strong></li><li><strong>Clothing/items: The better material or prepare to purchase/rent this after consultation.</strong></li><li><strong>Indication of condition: able to cycle a long distance (50km) without issues within 2.5 hours, able to walk longer distances (10+km).</strong></li><li>Expedition materials, meals, snacks, and kite materials are included.</li></ul><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767730-487a0542/DSC00021.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767728" data-original-src="/web/image/767728-487a0542/DSC00021.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767728"/></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767732-86bd2176/2020-03-13%2009.25.00.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767729" data-original-src="/web/image/767729-86bd2176/2020-03-13%2009.25.00.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-resize-width="NaN" loading="lazy" data-attachment-id="767729"/></p><p class="lead"><img src="/web/image/767738-a2db2dec/IMG_5169.jpg" alt="" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-mimetype="image/webp" data-original-id="767733" class="o_translate_inline btn btn-primary" href="/en/snowkitetrip#skt-form">Boeken</a></p></div>
                    </section><section class="s_text_block pt0 pb64 o_colored_level" data-snippet="s_text_block" data-name="Section">
                        <div class="s_allow_columns container"><h2 id="table_of_content_heading_2_12" class="h3" data-anchor="true"><font class="text-o-color-1">Extra baggage and renting ski equipment</font><br/></h2><div class="s_hr pt8 pb24" data-snippet="s_hr" data-name="Separator"><hr class="w-100 mx-auto"/></div><ul class="lead"><li>Is the 20kg that is standard included in the trip not enough?<br/>It is possible to bring extra luggage from the Netherlands.<br/>For € 70,- you can bring a total of 35 kg (20+15kg)<img src="/web/image/907349-1b262445/IMG_20200301_091126.jpg" alt="" data-attachment-id="907346" class="img img-fluid o_we_custom_image" data-format-mimetype="image/webp" data-resize-width="793" data-original-id="907346" data-original-src="/web/image/907346-f0f8b52f/IMG_20200301_091126.jpg" data-mimetype-before-conversion="image/jpeg" data-mimetype="image/webp" loading="lazy"/></li><li class="oe-nested"><br/></li><li>Snowkite suitable skis, snowboards, and boots are available for rent through us:</li><li>For touring, you want skis with bindings that allow for touring and skins to be able to walk up elevation changes.</li><li class="oe-nested">You can rent these skis with corresponding skins and shoes through us in Norway, everything will be ready at the hotel upon arrival.</li><li class="oe-nested">--&gt; Rent includes compact folding trekking poles.</li><li>Are you going snowboarding? Then you can also rent one in Norway. Same as the skis, they are ready upon arrival<br/>--&gt; Rental includes inflatable snow shoes.</li><li>Due to the distance from the landlord, daily rental is unfortunately not possible.</li></ul></div>
